project.name: Sylphx App Template
project.summary: Next.js template for creating Sylphx Platform applications with the Sylphx SDK pre-configured.
goals: Provide a minimal production-shaped Next.js App Router template for new Sylphx Platform apps.
Demonstrate the expected Sylphx SDK configuration and environment variable contract.
Keep generated app scaffolding separate from platform service implementation.
nonGoals: Own the Sylphx Platform backend services or SDK implementation.
Own the product roadmap or runtime behavior of apps generated from the template.
Own enterprise engineering doctrine, standards, or project manifest schema.

owns.name: nextjs-template
owns.description: Template source files, README, sample Next.js routes, and local package metadata for creating Sylphx Platform apps.

owns.name: template-sdk-contract-example
owns.description: The documented app-level environment variables and example Sylphx SDK usage that generated applications can adapt.

doesNotOwn: The Sylphx SDK package implementation or platform backend services.
Generated applications, their product-specific business logic, or their production deployment decisions.
Enterprise doctrine and manifest schema owned by SylphxAI/doctrine.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema and engineering doctrine

forbiddenCouplings: Do not add product-specific behavior from a generated app back into the template.
Do not implement platform backend services or SDK internals in this template repository.
Do not fork doctrine standards into this repository.

delivery.deployPath: not-applicable: this repository is a template, not a deployed product runtime.
delivery.productionProof: npm run build plus generated-app smoke test that verifies documented environment variables and Sylphx SDK imports.

gaps.description: No GitHub Actions workflow or required admission context currently protects the template.
gaps.target: central ADR-29 required-context rollout or repo-local Next.js template CI gate

gaps.description: The README references create-sylphx-app, but this repository does not yet record generated-app smoke proof for the template contract.
gaps.target: template release or generator integration follow-up

gaps.description: package.json is named my-sylphx-app, which is appropriate for a generated app but should be explicit in template release tooling.
